name: Xaldia
summary:
Xaldia is a browser-based 2D fantasy MMORPG set in a persistent online world.

Players explore a fantasy environment, complete quests, battle monsters, develop their characters, and participate in multiplayer activities including cooperative raids, PvP combat, and parties.

The game features character progression, equipment, spells, dungeons, bosses, and gathering activities such as fishing, mining, and woodcutting.

Xaldia combines top-down 2D role-playing gameplay with real-time online multiplayer systems. Players can access the game directly through a modern web browser.

The game is currently in active development, with additional content, gameplay systems, and world features continuing to evolve.
